The joined process fixture runs an ordinary checklist check, its settled-Round
assessment, one receipt-derived typed follow-up and the second assessment.
Runtime tools assemble the check packages; model responses supply bounded
judgments and inspect only declared Run-local context. The test never seeds
settled item, receipt, snapshot or accepted membership rows.
JSON descriptors use read_artifact; binary result packages use the existing
exact open_source_archive and bounded read_source tools. Full package bytes
are compared independently through the real ArtifactStore and public client.

An injected publication conflict permits pause, producer deletion and Server
restart before either assessment consumes the exact retained source. The
original proposal and result bytes are captured before deletion and compared
with retained and consumer bytes. Explicit owner triage confirms the finding.

The separate bypass cases execute a standalone tool Worker with zero model
calls and an unchanged default deterministic checklist inventory without any
snapshot, typed plan or input-materialization checkpoint. The local scanner
executable is a deterministic protocol fixture, not scanner-quality evidence.
